Buttons:
- Play
Check if cards in play area are face down.
If so flip cards, otherwise draw one card and play

- Clean
Moves all cards in play cards area to discards

- Draw
Draws card from deck till handlimit is reached

-Discard
Discard/Move card from deck to discard deck.
Is needed for Upgrade Cards

Traffic-Lights:
It's just a simple display to show you have placed your cards and are now waiting for the other players.
If you click the traffic-light of your color it will switch to yellow (totally unimportant which color it is at this moment).
If you click the play button and your cards are flipped the light will be switch to green.
After you played your turn an pushing the clean button, the light will switch to red.

Championship:
To play championship you have to start a game with option "championship (start)". This will make most setups. You have to choose which routes you want to drive.
After that you have to open the menue again (little button on top right) and choose "championship (next race)" and the route. Also you can choose to use weather and/or legends.
This will prepare and setup the route to play. After that you have to handel upgrades, sponsorcards and press corner for yourself.

                obj.destruct()
            end

    end

    local seatedPlayers = getSeatedPlayers()
    -- reset gears and cars
    for colorIndex = 1, 6 do
        local color = (colors[colorIndex])
        local pos = player[color]["playerBoard"].getPosition()
        local gearStickPosition = {pos[1]+10.75,pos[2]+1,pos[3]-6.34}
        player[color]["gearStick"].setRotation({0, 0, 0})
        player[color]["gearStick"].setPositionSmooth(gearStickPosition)

        local raceCar = getObjectFromGUID(player[color]["raceCar1"]) or getObjectFromGUID(player[color]["raceCar2"]) or getObjectFromGUID(player[color]["raceCar3"]) or getObjectFromGUID(player[color]["raceCar4"])
        raceCar.setPositionSmooth({pos[1]+14.16,pos[2]+1,pos[3]-6.34})
        raceCar.setRotation({0,45,0})

        -- setLights
        if checkSeated(color) == false then
            -- cleanPlayerAreas for non-drivers
            if settings["championshipContinue"] != true then
        cleanAllCardsInPlayerArea(color)
        end
        readyLightsCard.call('setOff', {color = color})
        else
            readyLightsCard.call('setStop', {color = color})
        end
    end
end

function checkSeated(color)
    for _, seatedColor in pairs(getSeatedPlayers()) do

    end
    return false

function preparePlayerBoardsDecksAndWeather_coroutine()
    local amountHeatCards = 6
    local amountStressCards = 3
    local changeHeatToDiscard = false
    local changeHeatToDraw = false
    --weatherTokens   
    if settings["weather"] == true then
        local champBoardPos = championShipBoard.getPosition()
        local weatherTokenBag = weatherTokensBag.takeObject()
        weatherTokenBag.shuffle()
        if settings["championship"] == true then
            weatherTokenBag.setRotation({0,270,0})
            weatherTokenBag.setPositionSmooth({champBoardPos[1],2,champBoardPos[3]-4})
            Sleep(1.5)
            weatherTokenBag.setLock(true)
        else
            for i=1, track[currentTrack]["amount"] do
                local weatherToken = weatherTokenBag.takeObject()
                local tokenType = nil
                if weatherToken.hasTag("straight") then
                    tokenType = "straight"
                elseif weatherToken.hasTag("curve") then
                    tokenType = "curve"
                end

                local pos = track[currentTrack][tokenType][i].getPosition()
                local rot = track[currentTrack][tokenType][i].getRotation()

                weatherToken.setRotation(rot)
                weatherToken.setPositionSmooth(pos)
            end
            if settings["championshipContinue"] == true then
                weatherTokenBag.setRotation({0,270,0})
                weatherTokenBag.setPositionSmooth({champBoardPos[1],2,champBoardPos[3]-4})
                Sleep(1.5)
                weatherTokenBag.setLock(true)
            else
                weatherTokenBag.destruct()
            end
        end
        --weatherCard
        local weatherCards = weatherCardsBag.takeObject()
        weatherCards.shuffle()

        if settings["championship"] == true then
            weatherCards.setRotation({0,180,180})
            weatherCards.setPositionSmooth({champBoardPos[1],2,champBoardPos[3]+11})
        else
            local weatherCard = weatherCards.takeObject()
            local pos = track[currentTrack]["weatherCard"].getPosition()
            weatherCard.setPositionSmooth(pos)
            weatherCard.setRotation({0,180,0})

            if weatherCard.hasTag("minusHeat") then amountHeatCards = amountHeatCards -1
            elseif weatherCard.hasTag("plusHeat") then amountHeatCards = amountHeatCards + 1
            elseif weatherCard.hasTag("minusStress") then amountStressCards = amountStressCards -1
            elseif weatherCard.hasTag("plusStress") then amountStressCards = amountStressCards + 1
            elseif weatherCard.hasTag("heatToDiscard") then changeHeatToDiscard = true
            elseif weatherCard.hasTag("heatToDraw") then changeHeatToDraw = true
            end
            if settings["championshipContinue"] == true then
                weatherCards.setRotation({0,180,180})
                weatherCards.setPositionSmooth({champBoardPos[1],2,champBoardPos[3]+11})
            else
                weatherCards.destruct()
            end
        end
    end
    -- keep Card Decks (championshipContinue)
    if settings["championshipContinue"] == true then
        for _, color in pairs(getSeatedPlayers()) do
            local pos = player[color]["playerBoard"].getPosition()
            local deckPosition = player[color]["playerDrawDeckArea"].getPosition()
            local counter = 0
            local newDeck = nil
            for _, obj in pairs( player[color]["playerArea"].getObjects() ) do
                if obj.type == "Deck" or obj.type == "Card" and not obj.hasTag("button") then
                    counter = counter + 1
                    if counter == 1 then
                        newDeck = obj
                        newDeck.setPosition(deckPosition)
                        newDeck.setRotation({0,180,180})
                    else
                        newDeck = newDeck.putObject(obj)
                    end
                end
            end
            -- check deck for amount of heat (without bonus) and stress cards
            local heatCount = 0
            local stressCount = 0
            local quantity = newDeck.getQuantity()
            for i=1, quantity do
                local card = newDeck.takeObject({position = {deckPosition[1],2+(0.1*quantity)-(0.1 * i),deckPosition[3]}})
                if card.hasTag("heat") and not card.hasTag("bonus") then
                    heatCount = heatCount + 1
                    if heatCount > amountHeatCards then
                        card.destruct()
                    end
                elseif card.hasTag("stress") then
                    stressCount = stressCount + 1
                    if stressCount > amountStressCards then
                        card.destruct()
                    end
                end
            end
            Sleep(2)
            for _, obj in pairs( player[color]["playerArea"].getObjects() ) do
                if obj.type == "Deck" or obj.type == "Card" and not obj.hasTag("button") then
                    newDeck = obj
                end
            end
            if heatCount < amountHeatCards then
                for i=1, (amountHeatCards - heatCount) do
                    newDeck.putObject(heatCardBag.takeObject())
                end
            end
            if stressCount < amountStressCards then
                for i=1, (amountStressCards - stressCount) do
                    newDeck.putObject(stressCardBag.takeObject())
                end
            end
        end

    else
        -- setup new cards
        for _, color in pairs(getSeatedPlayers()) do
            cleanAllCardsInPlayerArea(color)
            local deckPosition = player[color]["playerDrawDeckArea"].getPosition()
            local newDeck = player[color]["raceDeckBag"].takeObject()
            newDeck.setPosition(deckPosition)
            newDeck.setRotation({0,180,180})

            if settings["starterUpgrades"] then
                local starterUpgrades = player[color]["starterUpgradesDeckBag"].takeObject()
                newDeck.putObject(starterUpgrades)
            end

            for i=1, amountHeatCards do
                newDeck.putObject(heatCardBag.takeObject())
            end
            for i=1, amountStressCards do
                newDeck.putObject(stressCardBag.takeObject())
            end
        end
    end
    Sleep(3)
    -- reset everything
    for _, color in pairs(getSeatedPlayers()) do
        local newDeck = nil
        for _, obj in pairs( player[color]["playerDrawDeckArea"].getObjects() ) do
            if obj.type == "Deck" then
                newDeck = obj
            end
        end

        local quantity = newDeck.getQuantity()
        local pos = newDeck.getPosition()
        local discardPos = player[color]["playerDiscardDeckArea"].getPosition()
        local heatPos = player[color]["playerHeatDeckArea"].getPosition()
        local heatCounter = 0
        for i=1, quantity do
            local card = newDeck.takeObject({position = {pos[1],2+(0.1*quantity)-(0.1 * i),pos[3]}})
            if card.hasTag("sponsor") or card.hasTag("upgrade") then
                card.deal(1,color)
            elseif card.hasTag("heat") and not card.hasTag("basic") then
                heatCounter = heatCounter + 1
                if changeHeatToDiscard == true and heatCounter < 4 then
                    card.setRotation({0,180,0})

--Alters scale of elements and moves them
function changeTableScale(width, depth)
    --Scaling factors used to translate scale to position offset
    local width2pos = (width-1) * 18
    local depth2pos = (depth-1) * 18

    --Hand zone movement
    if checkData.move == true then
        for _, pc in ipairs(ref_playerColor) do
            if Player[pc].getHandCount() > 0 then
                moveHandZone(Player[pc], width2pos, depth2pos)
            end
        end
    end
    --Hand zone scaling
    --The button to enable this was disabled for technical reasons
    if checkData.scale == true then
        for _, pc in ipairs(ref_playerColor) do
            if Player[pc].getHandCount() > 0 then
                scaleHandZone(Player[pc], width, depth)
            end
        end
    end

    --Resizing table elements
    obj_side_top.setScale({width, 1, 1})
    obj_side_bot.setScale({width, 1, 1})
    obj_side_lef.setScale({depth, 1, 1})
    obj_side_rig.setScale({depth, 1, 1})
    obj_surface.setScale({width, 1, depth})

    --Moving table elements to accomodate new scale
    obj_side_lef.setPosition({-width2pos,tableHeightOffset,0})
    obj_side_rig.setPosition({ width2pos,tableHeightOffset,0})
    obj_side_top.setPosition({0,tableHeightOffset, depth2pos})
    obj_side_bot.setPosition({0,tableHeightOffset,-depth2pos})
    obj_leg1.setPosition({-width2pos,tableHeightOffset,-depth2pos})
    obj_leg2.setPosition({-width2pos,tableHeightOffset, depth2pos})
    obj_leg3.setPosition({ width2pos,tableHeightOffset, depth2pos})
    obj_leg4.setPosition({ width2pos,tableHeightOffset,-depth2pos})
    self.setPosition(obj_leg4.positionToWorld({-22.12, 8.74,-19.16}))
    --Only enabled when changing tableHeightOffset
    --obj_surface.setPosition({0,tableHeightOffset,0})
end

--Move hand zone, p=player reference, facts are scaling factors
function moveHandZone(p, width2pos, depth2pos)
    local widthX = obj_side_rig.getPosition().x
    local depthZ = obj_side_top.getPosition().z
    for i=1, p.getHandCount() do
        local handT = p.getHandTransform()
        local pos = handT.position
        local y = handT.rotation.y

        if y<45 or y>320 or y>135 and y<225 then
            if pos.z > 0 then
                pos.z = pos.z + depth2pos - depthZ
            else
                pos.z = pos.z - depth2pos + depthZ
            end
        else
            if pos.x > 0 then
                pos.x = pos.x + width2pos - widthX
            else
                pos.x = pos.x - width2pos + widthX
            end
        end

        --Only enabled when changing tableHeightOffset
        --pos.y = tableHeightOffset + 14

        handT.position = pos
        p.setHandTransform(handT, i)
    end
end


---Scales hand zones, p=player reference, facts are scaling factors
function scaleHandZone(p, width, depth)
    local widthFact = width / obj_side_top.getScale().x
    local depthFact = depth / obj_side_lef.getScale().x
    for i=1, p.getHandCount() do
        local handT = p.getHandTransform()
        local scale = handT.scale
        local y = handT.rotation.y
        if y<45 or y>320 or y>135 and y<225 then
            scale.x = scale.x * widthFact
        else
            scale.x = scale.x * depthFact
        end
        handT.scale = scale
        p.setHandTransform(handT, i)
    end
end

function setReady(player, value, id)    
    local buttonColor = id
    buttonColor = string.gsub(buttonColor, "button", "")
    if player.color == buttonColor then
        self.UI.setAttribute(id, "image", "lightYellow")
        playerLights[player.color] = "yellow";
    end

    self.UI.setAttribute("button"..params["color"], "image", "lightGreen")
    playerLights[params["color"]] = "green";
end

    self.UI.setAttribute("button"..params["color"], "image", "lightRed")
    playerLights[params["color"]] = "red";
end

function setOff(params)
    self.UI.setAttribute("button"..params["color"], "image", "lightGrey")
    playerLights[params["color"]] = "off";

    playerCount = 0
    for colorIndex = 1, 6 do
        local color = (colors[colorIndex])
        if checkSeated(color) == false then
            playerLights[color] = "off";
        else
            playerCount = playerCount + 1
            playerLights[color] = "red";
        end        
    end
    setLights()
    positionLights()
end

function setLights()
    for colorIndex = 1, 6 do
        local color = (colors[colorIndex])
        if playerLights[color] == "off" then
            self.UI.setAttribute("panel"..color, "active", "false")
        else
            self.UI.setAttribute("panel"..color, "active", "true")
            if playerLights[color] == "red" then

    end

    local counter = 0

    end

    return false
